title: NEVER EXPLAIN. NEVER APOLOGIZE.

location.series: KMS TEAM / Audi and Audi Sport identity case study

slide_intent: Align wording, scale and image attitude because a brand’s voice is experienced through their combination.
strategic_value: A direct red statement beside an extreme portrait crop can give Audi Sport a confrontational, self-assured tone.
demonstration: Four left-aligned lines of uppercase red text occupy a pale field beside a tightly cropped face at the right edge; the Audi Sport signature sits below the text.
practical_value: Compare how the portrait crop and line breaks change the force of a short statement.

content_islands.name: Statement
content_islands.spec: Stack the red text at left with its two sentence stops.

content_islands.name: Signature
content_islands.spec: Place the red Audi Sport lockup directly beneath.

content_islands.name: Portrait crop
content_islands.spec: Fill the right side with an extreme facial close-up, allowing the left image area to stay pale behind the text.

reference_purposes.Expression: The terse wording, red capitals and tightly cropped portrait produce a distinctive campaign voice.
reference_purposes.Application: The identity is applied to a portrait-led Audi Sport statement.
